definition.def: If you are aware of something, you know about it.
examples: Smokers are well aware of the dangers to their own health. [+ of]
He should have been aware of what his junior officers were doing. [+ of]
Some people may not be aware that this was a problem.

definition.def: If you are aware of something, you realize that it is present or is happening because you hear it, see it, smell it, or feel it.
examples: She was acutely aware of the noise of the city. [+ of]
Jane was suddenly aware that she was digging her nails into her thigh.

definition.def: Someone who is aware notices what is happening around them or happening in the place where they live.
